name: std::visit_format_arg

declarations.code:
template <class Visitor, class Context>

/* see below */ visit_format_arg(Visitor &&vis, std::basic_format_arg<Context> arg);

intro:
Applies the visitor vis to the object contained in arg.

Equivalent to std::visit(std::forward<Visitor>(vis), value), where value is the std::variant stored in arg.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
vis

 -

  a Callable that accepts every possible alternative from arg


  arg

 -

  a std::basic_format_arg to be visited

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The value returned by the selected invocation of the visitor.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: As of C++26, std::visit_format_arg is deprecated in favor of the visit member functions of std::basic_format_arg.

summary: Applies the visitor vis to the object contained in arg.
